unresolved_semantics: The preview roster supplies seven player-controlled slots (001-007) and 32 Enemy038 boarders. Conditional slots 008/009 remain absent from the opening roster; their source installation is retained as skipped/provisional until the original registered-slot state is wired into this battle.

The 62 Enemy101 hulls and the four RainBOSS/Rain/RainSound objects remain static opening story objects, not playable units. The WINFAIL012 Enemy101 count condition therefore remains a provisional object-count boundary rather than a combat-unit claim.

WINFAIL012 round 8 fixes all 32 Enemy038 instances to source pixels; round 10 walks/deletes them, round 16/23 inserts the Enemy048 water creatures, and actSetPlayerFly is applied through the single unit dictionary. Script timing, collision, and water-creature placement remain remake pacing.

The six actChangePrevInsertObjectID(10000) writes are retained as insert receipts with no independent visual effect; source object identity and native object-table lifetime are static-derived, while the absence of a visual remake effect is provisional.

story_scene: Level 12 (巴瀚納海峽, bigmap.dat point 12, reached by ship from 薛維斯港 11): the
party on the deck in a storm — 雪拉 / 雷特 / 嚎 / 琥 banter, the rain controllers
and rain sound start, Enemy038 boarders climb aboard by displacement walks, 雷特
challenges them. The 62 Enemy101 船殼 hull pieces are stand objects (no walk
groups); 咕嚕 / 克羅蒂 are "有才產生" conditional installs and stay out.
